quotes.text: The future belongs to those who show up before it arrives.
quotes.author: MIRA VOSS

quotes.text: You do not find meaning; you forge it from the raw material of every day.
quotes.author: UNKNOWN

quotes.text: A machine can repeat a pattern. A person can break one.
quotes.author: K. ALETHEIA

quotes.text: Resistance is not always the enemy — sometimes it is the shape of the lesson.
quotes.author: J. REN

quotes.text: We are what we repeatedly attend to, not what we pretend to notice.
quotes.author: T. REINHART

quotes.text: To be outstanding is to be willing to be misunderstood for long stretches of time.
quotes.author: E. SALAZAR

quotes.text: The world does not owe you coherence. Build one anyway.
quotes.author: UNKNOWN

quotes.text: Distance is a decision, not a measurement.
quotes.author: A. RAHMAN

quotes.text: What you tolerate in silence becomes your new ceiling.
quotes.author: MIRA VOSS

quotes.text: The deepest form of freedom is the refusal to wait for permission.
quotes.author: L. CANDELA

quotes.text: Patience without direction is just decoration.
quotes.author: K. ALETHEIA

quotes.text: Every shortcut asks for a toll you usually do not see until later.
quotes.author: T. REINHART

quotes.text: Where you begin is not where you finish, but you are still required to start.
quotes.author: UNKNOWN

quotes.text: Attention is the most honest currency you will ever spend.
quotes.author: MIRA VOSS

quotes.text: A ship is safe in the harbor — but that is not what ships are for.
quotes.author: K. ALETHEIA

quotes.text: Clarity is not given; it is excavated, piece by piece.
quotes.author: J. REN

quotes.text: The quiet work outlives the loud announcement every time.
quotes.author: L. CANDELA

quotes.text: Learn to read the silence that follows your own noise.
quotes.author: E. SALAZAR

quotes.text: No one rises to low expectations, not even the ones who claim them.
quotes.author: T. REINHART

quotes.text: You do not need a larger audience; you need a sharper intention.
quotes.author: A. RAHMAN

quotes.text: What looks like a detour now will look like the path later.
quotes.author: MIRA VOSS

quotes.text: Be the kind of person your own best advice is addressed to.
quotes.author: UNKNOWN

quotes.text: You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
quotes.author: MARCUS AURELIUS

quotes.text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
quotes.author: MARCUS AURELIUS

quotes.text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
quotes.author: MARCUS AURELIUS

quotes.text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
quotes.author: MARCUS AURELIUS

quotes.text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
quotes.author: SENECA

quotes.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
quotes.author: SENECA

quotes.text: Difficulty strengthens the mind, as labor does the body.
quotes.author: SENECA

quotes.text: While we wait for life, life passes.
quotes.author: SENECA

quotes.text: In the depth of winter, I finally learned that within me there lay an invincible summer.
quotes.author: ALBERT CAMUS

quotes.text: The only way to deal with an unfree world is to become so absolutely free that your very existence is an act of rebellion.
quotes.author: ALBERT CAMUS

quotes.text: You will never be happy if you continue to search for what happiness consists of.
quotes.author: ALBERT CAMUS

quotes.text: It is not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
quotes.author: EPICTETUS

quotes.text: No man is free who is not master of himself.
quotes.author: EPICTETUS

quotes.text: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
quotes.author: EPICTETUS

quotes.text: Man is condemned to be free; because once thrown into the world, he is responsible for everything he does.
quotes.author: JEAN-PAUL SARTRE
